title: Canonical comparison for successive open module restrictions
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $T\subseteq V\subseteq U$ be opens of $X$, and write $i:T\to V$ and $j:V\to U$ for the inclusions. Write $r_j$ and $r_i$ for restriction of sheaves of modules from $U$ to $V$ and from $V$ to $T$, using the localized open-site categories canonically equivalent to module sheaves on the open subschemes. The ordinary composition comparison is the natural isomorphism $r_i\circ r_j\xrightarrow{\sim}r_{j\circ i}$ whose maps on every section of every restricted module are identities. Fix derived categories $D(\mathcal O_U)$, $D(\mathcal O_V)$ and $D(\mathcal O_T)$ in a common morphism universe [def-pc-derived-category]. The derived composition comparison is the natural isomorphism $D(r_i)\circ D(r_j)\xrightarrow{\sim}D(r_{j\circ i})$ obtained by the inverse canonical comparison from the composition of the exact-functor induced derived functors to the functor induced by their composition, followed by the derived image of the ordinary composition comparison. These specify the canonical comparisons, not arbitrary natural isomorphisms.

def derivedModuleOpenMapCompIso (X : Scheme.{u}) {T V U : X.Opens}
    (i : T ⟶ V) (j : V ⟶ U)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over V))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over T))] :
    (SheafOfModules.overMap.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) j).mapDerivedCategory ⋙
      (SheafOfModules.overMap.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) i).mapDerivedCategory ≅
    (SheafOfModules.overMap.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) (i ≫ j)).mapDerivedCategory
